1.title: AI Will Cure Disease and Push Space Frontiers | Sangeen Zeb
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Google Ventures partner discusses Sierra's $30B Series F valuation and enterprise growth trajectory; explores AI applications in healthcare, legal, and drug discovery through portfolio companies including Harvey and Isomorphic Labs.

2.title: Why Vibe Coding Won’t Kill SaaS | Sukhinder Singh Cassidy
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Xero CEO on small business AI adoption patterns, why traditional SaaS won't be disrupted by "vibe coding," market volatility in frontier AI spending, and enterprise vs SMB AI bifurcation forecast for 2027.

1.title: Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Blind benchmark across six frontier models (GPT-6.2, Claude Opus/Fable, Gemini Neon/Carbon) on 25 tasks; introduces "Annoyance Bench" eval built from agent session data; covers coding, creative, prototyping, speed-cost tradeoffs.

2.title: Anthropic’s Margins Are Being Squeezed | Tomasz Tunguz
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Tomasz Tunguz analyzes AI lab unit economics post-Anthropic IPO: GPU costs rising, token prices falling, margin compression; predicts US compute bottleneck forces token imports by 2028–30; local models handling 90% of laptop tasks.

3.title: Can True Art Survive the YouTube Algorithm?
3.author: Colin and Samir
3.hook: Max Joseph (editor of Casey Neistat's "Make It Count") discusses how the YouTube algorithm rewards repetition vs. artistic integrity, the history of that 2012 Nike video's impact on the creator economy, and practical advice for artists navigating algorithmic constraints.
